note: Status per packet DRY family: concretized (this concept renders a native composition of the role), reused (consumed via shared data/semantics without new composition), not-exercised (not part of this concept's surfaces). Variance notes are the anti-clone evidence: same product behavior, deliberately different composition from the six sibling concepts.

entries.variance_notes: Destinations are large single-column editorial rows with small-caps numerals, title, one description line, and a quiet count - no cards, tiles, or grids anywhere. The same twelve destinations persist as a text-led rail.
At most one scenario-gated banner; attention items are ruled list rows with a status word, headline, and consequence sentence - never a CTA wall.
One bounded-measure reading column beside a stable 218px text rail; the rail never disappears and never overlays; depth changes only the column content.
The Home field is typography (underline rule, display face), not a boxed widget; the dropdown is a compact anchored typographic list with slim uppercase group headers.
Pure text links with quiet counts; no icons in the rail, no pills, no accent bars. Narrow widths swap the rail for a topbar crumb selector popup.
Longform deliberately has no scrollspy; subgroup deep links scroll to their ruled section heading instead, keeping route replacement out of ordinary reading.
A two-column paragraph: title+desc on the reading side, control+chips on the right margin; state notes are italic lines inside the row; at narrow widths the control drops under the text.
Shared chip silhouettes; Longform suppresses the default chip when the control already shows the value and compresses custom to the one word 'Changed'.
Reasons are quiet sentences (italic under rows, after struck-through action links, under search results) - never bare badges.
Managers are chapters of the same longform page: editorial header, quiet action links, ruled sections. No console, no side inspector, no slides between managers.
Selection slides a restrained detail sheet INTO the reading column above the roster (in-flow, pushing content); objects without pages expand a technical drawer under their own row instead.
Checks are ruled entries with a status phrase and a consequence sentence; Doctor reads as prose, not gauges.
Numbered counter-rendered steps with official source and host/environment lines; the Cursor CLI offer keeps install and sign-in visibly separate.
One truthful op sentence per surface: name, status, phase, and 'n of m' only with a real denominator; terminal tones recolor the left rule. Never a spinner-only treatment.

entries.concept_component: PMShell.toast over store receipt events + c06-receipt panel
entries.variance_notes: Receipts surface as toasts; the copy transaction renders a standing receipt panel with restore point and receipt ids.

entries.concept_component: credential note in copy preview + provider detail fields
entries.variance_notes: Secrets appear only as vault/keychain reference prose; no reveal or copy affordance exists anywhere in the concept.

entries.concept_component: c06-entry provider roster grouped by connection kind
entries.variance_notes: Providers are ruled roster entries under uppercase group heads with a status word and consequence note - no card grid.

entries.concept_component: accounts tab section in the provider sheet
entries.variance_notes: Accounts render as roster entries with identity, health word, and the CLI-owned sign-in boundary sentence above them.

entries.concept_component: installs tab entries with shadow/manual-only notes
entries.variance_notes: One entry per installation with confidence and update status; shadowed and manual-only reasons print as italic sentences; actions come only from the shared resolver.

entries.concept_component: models table in the provider sheet (c06-table)
entries.variance_notes: Models are a real five-column table inside its own horizontal-scroll container - the one deliberately tabular surface in an otherwise prose concept.

entries.concept_component: limits tab kv lines over usageSnapshot
entries.variance_notes: Read-only projection; Settings never recalculates balances.

A narrow focused sheet inside the reading column with a four-stop step line; counts read as editorial figures; items are a kind-labelled inspection list. One-time language throughout; no sync options exist.
Editorial-lite fixed-height rows (label over full path, chips right) windowed over the flat list; facets are popup menus, not a filter bar of pills.
Shared chrome by contract - a test affordance, not Settings UI.
Dashed-rule note naming owner, deep link, reachable-from, and return contract verbatim, followed by the honest read-only sections; grouped on domain pages under 'Reserved destinations'.
